title: limonium endlichianum
intro: Limonium endlichianum, commonly known as the Androsan saltwort, is a plant species within the Plumbaginaceae family. The Androsan saltwort is a succulent shrub native to the island of Andros in the Bahamas. It has been used for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects. The therapeutic actions of Limonium endlichianum include wound healing and antimicrobial properties, attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds.
